learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to spot perfect geometric twins that match exactly in shape and size, and understand the secret rules of congruence!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: In math, when two shapes are exactly the same size and exactly the same shape, we call them 'congruent'. They are perfect copies of each other, like two identical biscuits from the same packet.

How do you check if shapes are twins? You use superposition! This simply means sliding, turning, or flipping one shape to place it directly on top of the other. If they cover each other perfectly, they are congruent.
Two straight lines are congruent if they have the exact same length. Two angles are congruent if they open up to the exact same degree measure. Size is all that matters!

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Digroz Twin Search
fun_activity.instructions: Go on a hunt around your house. Find 3 pairs of real-world objects that are perfectly congruent (like two identical coins or two fresh pages from a notebook) and test them using superposition!

quick_recap: ⭐ Congruent shapes are exactly identical in both shape and size.
⭐ Superposition is the method of placing one shape over another to check for a perfect match.
⭐ Line segments need the same length, and angles need the same degree to be congruent.
